CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, r REAL, x TEXT, n NUMERIC);
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1, 0.1, '0.1', '1.10'), (2, 1.0/3, 'x', 3.0), (3, 100.0, '1e3', 2.5), (4, 9007199254740993, 'abc', '9007199254740993'), (5, 4.35*100, '', 0.5);
SELECT id, r, x, n, typeof(r), typeof(n) FROM t ORDER BY id;
SELECT sum(r), avg(r), total(r), group_concat(r, ','), json_group_array(r), max(r), min(r) FROM t;
SELECT json_object('a', 0.1, 'b', 1.0/3), json('[0.1, 0.30000000000000004]'), json_extract('{"a":0.30000000000000004}', '$.a');
SELECT quote(0.1), quote(100.0), quote(1e100), quote(-2.5), quote(4.35), quote(0.5), quote(1e-7);
SELECT quote(1.0/3) LIKE '3.33333333333333%e-01', CAST(quote(1.0/3) AS REAL) = 1.0/3;
SELECT 10/4, 10/4.0, 5 % 3, 5.5 % 2, 1e999 > 0, abs(-0.0), 2.0 * 3, 7 / 2.0;
SELECT printf('%.2f %.3f %g %e', 2.675, 1.0005, 0.0001, 12345.678);
SELECT sqlite_version() >= '3.51.3';
